item.title: The Gap Between Kernels: Mapping a B200 and Measuring What CUDA Graphs Save
item.description: Learning notes from instrumented experiments on an NVIDIA B200: %globaltimer resolution, deterministic block placement, the GPC map recovered from thread-block clusters, eager launches vs CUDA graphs across kernel lengths and chain lengths, where launch data lives, programmatic dependent launch, and graph update and memory costs. With interactive figures built from the raw data.
